spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Are databases healthy, and can each application's data actually be recovered?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/operations/backups.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Expected databases
spec.description:
Expected database inventory by site/namespace/db_cluster. The Kubernetes site label is never overloaded with the CNPG name.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: CNPG role: in recovery
spec.description:
PostgreSQL's observed recovery state. Zero means primary role, not fencing proof. Same-name databases at two sites stay distinct.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Connections
spec.description:
Observed database connections; compare against the configured limit and wait/transaction evidence.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Replay timestamp lag
spec.description:
Replay timestamp lag can grow on idle databases. It is not by itself an RPO or a measure of unarchived writes.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Database state
spec.description:
Databases outside CloudNativePG (MongoDB for UniFi, Immich's Postgres, Plausible's ClickHouse, Valkey), which have no exporter: Healthy when every desired replica of the workload is ready, Standby at zero replicas, Unknown when the site doesn't report it. Ready means the pod passes its readiness checks; ClickHouse has none, so the Plausible service probe, which needs ClickHouse to answer, is its query evidence.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Database container restarts
spec.description:
Restarts in the last hour of the database containers, from kube-state-metrics. A crash loop can pass readiness between restarts.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Base backup age
spec.description:
Barman plugin's last successful base backup per database. The warning threshold is 30h; a missing metric is separately reported as missing coverage.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Backup coverage
spec.description:
Expected database left join observed Barman evidence. Missing series cannot be hidden by another database's fresh backup.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: WAL failures
spec.description:
Failed WAL archiving attempts. Idle WAL age alone is not a failure. Counted over the selected range, per site; anything but zero is red.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Weekly PVC drill age
spec.description:
The existing weekly job covers its configured PVC entries only. This does not certify every app or a database restore.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Recovery point by app
spec.description:
Per app and site: is its oldest newest-backup, over every scheduled PVC and every primary database, within its recovery point objective (inventory.py OBJECTIVES: 30 h, a daily backup plus slack)? Unknown when a piece has no backup evidence. A site where nothing is scheduled, like a standby, shows a dash.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Backup age by app
spec.description:
The oldest piece's backup age per app and site: the data an unplanned restore would lose, at most.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Restore time by app
spec.description:
Per warm app with PVCs: did its last standby restore drill write the data back within the restore time objective (1 h)? Measured on the standby; Not applicable where the app runs. Unknown until a drill reports how long it took. This is the data restore, not the whole failover.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Last drill duration
spec.description:
From each Restore's creation to its Ready condition, the slowest PVC of the app's last successful drill.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: PVCs without a backup schedule

defaults.noValue: Every PVC is scheduled on a site

spec.description:
PVCs the failover catalogue moves that no site has a running backup schedule for: a suspended schedule, or no SnapshotPolicy covering the PVC. Their recovery point is unbounded.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Windows disk free
spec.description:
Physical Windows free capacity. WSL's virtual disk maximum is not an independent physical capacity budget.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
